title: Perfectness of a pseudo-coherent complex over a flat local extension with regular fibre, from one fibre computation at the closed point
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The statement is the local form of the perfectness criterion for a flat local ring homomorphism A -> B whose fibre B over m_A B is regular of dimension d, and it is content with a single cohomological input at the closed point of A, namely the vanishing of H^i(K tensor^L_A kappa(m_A)) outside [a, b] (statement lines 20228-20244). The proof replaces K by a bounded above complex of finite free modules, then computes the derived fibre at the closed point of B through the three equalities of the display, whose justification uses flatness of K over A and of the fibre over A over B over m_A B, and finally combines the cohomology bound with the finite global dimension of the regular fibre in the spectral sequence of the tensor product of complexes (proof lines 20247-20271). What makes the argument work is that everything is reduced to a single fibre, which is why only the closed point appears in the hypothesis. The counted span refers to two items of this chapter and one proposition of another chapter, all carried as navigation stubs; the computation itself is inside the span.
